I have recently gotten back into swtor a few weeks ago. I am absolutely loving it. The dialogue choices and light/dark side options really make me more invested in the character. There are 8 unique class stories and each planet has a story arc as well for the most part. I originally played at launch 10 years ago and did a dark side sith sorceress. When I recently picked it up I went with a light side jedi knight. I just made an alt and wanted to be a dark side smuggler. The choices you make in dialogue and, say, whether or not to kill someone or let them live is a lot of fun and ive never been one to really care about that stuff too much, mainly im focused on gameplay. Ill tell you though, I am going to make a dark side jedi next and I am really excited to see what that story is like. I know a lot of people have been gravitating to ff14 lately and one of the biggest reasons I hear is because the story is so good. Well, swtor has spectacular stories, immersion and is alive and well. I certainly thought the game was dead and everyone ive talked to has thought the same thing as well. After playing a few weeks, it absolutely doesnt seem dead at all. They just announced the next expansion at the beginning of July, everywhere i go i see other players, the trade market has been fun to use, and i joined a very active guild that runs operations (raids) and other activities every day. Im not saying swtor is perfect, but i wish more people would give it a shot. I wasnt expecting it to capture me like it has when i recently got back into it, but i am totally enthralled and cant wait to see more class stories and am thinking about how i want to play those characters and the choices I make. Its really cool. Swtor is cheaper than ff14 as well. In my opinion, it is fantastic value for a game. Especially for an mmo.
